newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Gilt, Euromark vols to edge higher.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Gilt, Euromark vols to edge higher.

text.p: Implied volatility levels of options on gilt and euromark futures were higher on Thursday and were set to rise further over the next few days, traders said.
"Next week there are a lot of figures out of the U.S. so vols should edge higher," said a trader on the LIFFE floor.

He said while there had been a lot of activity earlier in the session, trading had eased off and with no major data out of the U.S. to provide a focus for the market on Thursday, it would remain quiet for the rest of the session.
Brokers quoted implied volatility levels of options on gilt futures at 7.25 percent in Decmeber, compared with 6.96 percent at Wednesday's close.
"Volatility is probably slightly biased towards the upside," said a trader at a Japanese bank in London.
Traders said a U.S. bank had bought a total of around 5,000 lots of gilt options during the session.
The Japanese bank trader said the main trade of the session had been buying and selling of December 110.00 calls.
By 1320 GMT, around 2,300 lots at the 110.00 strike, 1,300 lots at the 111.00 strike and 1,000 lots at the 112.00 strike of Decmeber call options had been traded according to LIFFE data.
The underlying December gilt future was trading at 109-16, down 9/32 on the day.
Elsewhere, traders said Bunds options had been actively traded and volatility levels were expected to stabilise or slip lower.
Implied volatility of options on Euromarks was expected to remain stable in the front month but continue to pick in the back months, they said.
"We've seen continued interest in playing puts, primarily in June," the trader said. "Vol skew will continue to increase with the bias towards puts."
Euromark option implied volatility was quoted at 12.70 percent for December from 12.68 at Wednesday's close.
In the back months vol was at 15.75 percent for March and 20.50 percent for June, up from 16.30 percent and 19.97 percent respectively on late Wednesday.
December Euromarks were at 96.83, unchanged on the day.
